Name: Forest Lore
Author: Jared
Description: Forest Lore (early development) adds the forest's own landmarks, ruins and hidden places to the map. Barrow Wood, south of the Old Glade, has an Ancient Cairn to open, standing stones to read (a small calm, once a day) and search, a hollow oak to nap and sleep in, and a lone Weeping Pine that slowly gives resin. The Old Battlefield, north of the Moon Hills, can be searched for bones, bronze and, rarely, an old axe. The Abandoned Homestead, east of the Clay Banks, can be salvaged and repaired into a shelter with chest-sized storage and a grinding slab; like a vanilla Hideout it needs a plank now and then or it falls back into ruin. The Mud Springs, south of the Peat Bog, give mud, salt and tar that slowly refill, the mud volcano warms you, and at the deer lick you can wait for a doe or a stag to come down for the salt. Guano Rock, a short swim east of the Lake Island, gives manure. Digging peat can, rarely, turn up a Bog Body, now and then with an old copper ornament on it. West of the Old Hollow, a Rock Shelter leads down into the Sunken Caves: cave paintings, an ossuary where an old axe sometimes turns up, a squeeze only a light load fits through, and a lake that never freezes, to drink from and fish even in winter, whose small stock of eels refills about one a day. Carved Stairs and Fairy Hole Ladders can be built from a board's Improvements tab to make vanilla climbs safer. A save that already visited a place will not gain sites added later. Requires CSFFModFramework 2.28.0 or later.
